fullStackProjects.title: AttendX Nova
fullStackProjects.description: A full-featured attendance management platform (branded ClassRep Attendance Manager) built with React, TypeScript, and TanStack Start. Features biometric/WebAuthn fingerprint login, a guided multi-step onboarding flow, and a real-time analytics dashboard with animated count-up metrics, custom SVG gauges, and Recharts visualizations. Dark glassmorphism aesthetic with an indigo-to-violet design system and a responsive nav that adapts between mobile bottom-bar and desktop collapsible sidebar.

fullStackProjects.title: Live2D Playground
fullStackProjects.tagline: A professional workbench for Live2D models.
fullStackProjects.description: A tuning and debugging tool for Live2D Cubism 2/3/4 models — load any model, adjust scale and position, inspect motions, expressions and parameters, and export a ready-to-use JSON config. Built for animators and VTuber-style character workflows.

fullStackProjects.title: BioCycle Live (IoT)
fullStackProjects.tagline: Turning waste into energy — and data into insight.
fullStackProjects.description: An IoT monitoring dashboard for a solid waste processing system converting organic waste into fertilizer and biogas. Heavily animated live gauges and charts, macOS-style dock navigation, ambient WebAudio sound effects, and an editable, persisted profile page. Built with AI-assisted development (Lovable).

fullStackProjects.title: Aurora Motors (Car Showroom)
fullStackProjects.tagline: Bespoke performance vehicles, engineered for tomorrow.
fullStackProjects.description: A premium automotive showcase site for a fictional performance car brand, featuring cinematic hero visuals, smooth scroll-driven reveals, and a high-end dealership feel.

fullStackProjects.title: Vendor Management System
fullStackProjects.description: A frontend dashboard for managing vendor records, tracking relationships, and organizing procurement-style workflows with a clean, functional business-tool UI.

fullStackProjects.title: Digital Tamil Library
fullStackProjects.description: A UI concept for a digital library platform focused on Tamil-language literature and resources, designed with a clean, readable, culturally-rooted interface.

fullStackProjects.title: Bend Subway Management System
fullStackProjects.description: A management system interface for subway/transit operations, covering task and workflow tracking with a structured, operations-dashboard layout.

fullStackProjects.title: Supermarket POS (Smart Billing System)
fullStackProjects.description: A point-of-sale and billing system UI for supermarkets — handling item entry, cart management, and checkout flows with a fast, retail-optimized interface.

fullStackProjects.title: VaultAuth — Fingerprint WebAuthn Demo
fullStackProjects.description: A standalone WebAuthn/FIDO2 demo: register a fingerprint credential once, then sign in instantly via platform biometrics — no passwords. Shows a live session log with credential/verification details, built natively on the browser's Credential Management API (no external library).
